name: RetentionPatterns
description: Similar Retention (sprint 3.2): per item, three PatternItems only in the list RetentionPatternFixtures.s_listed, two in that list and in the dictionary s_indexed, and one held by a PatternHolder in the array s_holders.
notes: Similar Retention of PatternItem gives exactly these three groups. Key paths alone cannot tell the second group from the first: its shortest path may run through either collection. Grouped by interface, every PatternDerived counts under Fixtures.Leaks.IPatternMarker (inherited from PatternBase) and under System.IEquatable<Fixtures.Leaks.PatternDerived>.
